meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 当主持人,把你的各个 git worktree、分支或 PR 当作独立 agent 拉进同一个共享聊天文件,分轮对话比对改动,最终给出一份整合方案:目标 worktree 与合并顺序。全程只读,不提交也不合并。
howto.when: 当你想把散在多个 git worktree、分支或 PR 的改动放到一起比对时触发。若只有一个或零个候选,它会说明这不算 standup,建议放宽范围后停止。

say.text: 给最近 24 小时有改动的 worktree 开一场 standup
say.note: 它会列出候选 worktree 让你确认名单

say.text: 把我的分支 feature-x 和这个 PR 也加进 standup
say.note: 按编号选择加入房间的分支和 PR

say.text: 把 standup 的结论交给 /do 去执行合并
say.note: 合并由 /do 执行,standup 本身不合并

howto.what_en: Claude acts as facilitator: each git worktree (and any PR you pick) joins a shared markdown chat as its own agent, debating in rounds to produce one consolidation plan — target worktree plus merge order. Read-only; nothing is merged.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want changes scattered across several git worktrees, branches or PRs compared together. With zero or one candidate it says that isn't a standup and stops.

say_en.text: Run a standup on worktrees active in the last 24 hours
say_en.note: It lists candidate worktrees for you to confirm

say_en.text: Add my branch feature-x and this PR to the standup
say_en.note: Pick branches and PRs by number to join the room

say_en.text: Hand the standup plan to /do to run the merges
say_en.note: Standup itself never commits or merges
